lines.en: Would you like to respond?
lines.zh: 要回复吗?

lines.en: What would you like to say?
lines.zh: 你想说什么?

lines.en: : {i}I really like your new swimsuit. It looks great on you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我很喜欢你的新泳衣。穿在你身上很好看。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Thank you so much :){/i}
: {i}Rin's is much better, though. It fits her a lot more.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过 Rin 那件好看多了。它更合身。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Well, with a chest as large as yours, you can't really expect everything to fit perfectly.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯，胸像你这么大的话，也不能指望每件衣服都完美合身。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I...meant her personality. Hahahah{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我……说的是她的性格。哈哈哈{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Mine is just striped and...I don't really think something like that says a lot about who I am as a person.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我那件只是条纹的而已……而且我觉得那种东西也说明不了我是什么样的人。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Maybe you should get one with...books all over it or something?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}也许你该买一件……印满书之类的？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yes. Because that is a swimsuit I am sure exists :P{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是啊。因为那种泳衣肯定存在嘛 :P{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Hey, I don't know. I just don't want you talking about other people when you're the one I'm complimenting.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嘿，我哪知道。我只是不想让你在我是夸你的那个人的时候去聊别人。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That's very sweet of you, Sensei :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你真好，Sensei :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'm glad you think I'm cute.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}很高兴你觉得我可爱。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You're not so bad yourself :))){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你自己也不差嘛 :))){/i}

lines.en: : {i}Is that code for “Come over so we can pleasure each other?”{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这是「过来让我们互相取悦一下」的暗号吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It is...{/i}
: {i}I'm still with Rin.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我现在还和 Rin 在一起。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That's fine. I'm sure she'd be happy to watch.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}没关系。我相信她会很乐意看着的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But I wouldn't be happy to show her :P{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可是我不会乐意给她看 :P{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'll be thinking of you, though :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过我会想你的 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}In a sexual way or a normal way?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是色情意义上的想，还是正常意义上的？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}In an “I wish you were here” way.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是「真希望你在这里」的那种想。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You can imagine that means whatever you want :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你可以把它想象成任何你想要的意思 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}It looks like you two were having fun. Wish I could have been there as well.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}看起来你们两个玩得很开心。真希望我也在那儿。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}We had a lot of fun!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我们玩得超开心！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I used to go to the beach a lot when I was younger, but Rin was never really able to until she was a [teenager].{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我小时候常去海边，但 Rin 一直没能去，直到她长到 [teenager] 那么大。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}We're making up for lost time now, I suppose :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我想，我们现在是在补回逝去的时光 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}When you put it like that, I feel like I'd just be getting in the way.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你这么一说，我觉得我要是去了只会碍事。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I didn't mean it like that at all!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我完全不是那个意思！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}We love you :) So we obviously want you to be here as well.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我们爱你 :) 所以我们当然也希望你能在这儿。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It would be ten times more fun if we could all have fun together.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}如果我们能一起玩，肯定会好玩十倍。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Oh God. That looks a lot more embarrassing when it's written down. I'm sorry, hahahah.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}天啊。写下来看着比说出来尴尬多了。抱歉，哈哈哈。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It's fine. I'm glad you two are having a good time.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}没事。我很高兴你们两个玩得开心。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Feel free to send me more pictures. Especially in the event of any wardrobe malfunctions.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}尽管多发点照片给我。尤其是万一发生什么走光事故的话。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Sorry, Sensei. I have to go. Rin's top just got lost in the ocean.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}抱歉，Sensei。我得挂了。Rin 的上衣刚被海冲走了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Futaba...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Futaba……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Kidding :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}开玩笑的 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}I miss you, though.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过，我想你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Let's...do something soon :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我们……找个时间一起做点什么吧 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}Sounds good to me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}听起来不错。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Enjoy the ocean or whatever.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好好享受大海什么的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Enjoy whatever you're doing right now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}也好好享受你现在正在做的事。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}How were you able to wear those swimsuits in the middle of winter?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你们怎么能在大冬天穿那种泳衣？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It was...very difficult for both of us. Hahahaha.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那对我们两个来说……都非常艰难。哈哈哈哈。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}The cold doesn't bother me all too much, but...it's a different story when you're wearing a swimsuit.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我其实不太怕冷，不过……穿着泳衣的时候就是另一回事了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}We wanted to enjoy the trip the best we could, though. So...yeah :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过我们想尽量享受这趟旅行。所以……嗯 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}You're lucky you got to stay clothed the whole weekend!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你真幸运，整个周末都能穿着衣服！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Am I really, though?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可我真的幸运吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I was about to say yes but then I realized you were being a pervert again :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我正要说「是」呢，然后我意识到你又在耍流氓了 :){/i}

lines.en: : {i}Atta girl.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这才对嘛。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I think you should still be happy, though :P Wouldn't IT get smaller in the cold?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过我觉得你还是该高兴才对 :P 天冷的时候它不会变小吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Not when it's hard.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}硬起来的时候不会。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Really? I didn't know they worked that way :O{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}真的吗？我都不知道原来是这么运作的 :O{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I would have been happy to show you had you actually invited me wherever you two went.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}要是你真邀请我一起去你们去的地方，我本来会很乐意给你看的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yes, and I'm sure that Rin would have been very happy to see that :P{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是啊，我相信 Rin 看到那个一定会非常开心 :P{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I can't tell if you're being sarcastic or not, but I think we both know that's probably true.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不知道你是不是在说反话，但我想我们俩心里都清楚，那大概是真的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Hahahahaha{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哈哈哈哈哈{/i}

lines.en: : {i}For you, maybe. She'd probably feel very strange if I were involved. She's no Nodoka.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}对你来说也许是吧。要是我也掺和进来，她大概会觉得很不自在。她可不是 Nodoka。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Guess there's only one way to find out...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}看来只有一个办法能知道了……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Oh, look. My phone is about to die. I guess we'll never find out after all.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦，你看。我手机快没电了。看来我们终究是没法知道了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Goodnight, Sensei. I'll talk to you later :){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}晚安，Sensei。我们回头再聊 :){/i}
